production_source_manifest.algorithm: sha256 of UTF-8 path + space + raw-file SHA256 records, POSIX lexical order, LF separators, no final LF
production_source_manifest.scope: All src/**/*.py only; not tests, experiments, manuscript, or a Git commit
production_source_manifest.line_endings: File bytes are not normalized; checkout line-ending conversion changes the hash

operation_count_definition.cf_denominators_generated: Every yielded convergent denominator, including repeats, over all Q outcomes
operation_count_definition.bounded_denominators_tested: Yielded denominators in [1,B], including repeats; matches production verification attempts
operation_count_definition.divisibility_checks: One offline r-divides-v check per bounded denominator; not a scalar multiplication
operation_count_definition.statistic_gcd_updates: One gcd update per distinct accepted denominator per outcome, starting at zero
operation_count_definition.dp_gcd_updates: One gcd update per (current state, one-shot statistic) pair per DP step
operation_count_definition.scope: Offline model operations only, not gates or scalable online costs
